verdict.rationale: HMRC runs a live production REST API platform (Making Tax Digital) and a developer hub, so a test sandbox is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox or test environment. The only API probe hit the production host, and the developer-hub docs were not fetched, so the capability is unevidenced rather than shown to be absent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
